item.title: ‘America’s Got Talent’ Hopeful Has the Judges ‘Beggin” With His Take on the Måneskin Hit: Watch
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest updates on trending music and performances. Today, we're excited to share with you a sneak peek of an upcoming audition on America's Got Talent.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: US Army sergeant Isaak Atkins is taking the stage to perform his cover of Måneskin's hit song "Beggin'". This Italian rock band's song, which itself is a cover of the Four Seasons' 1960s track, peaked at number 13 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.
[Short clip of Isaak Atkins singing "Beggin'" plays]
Host: As you can hear, Isaak's powerful and passionate vocals bring a new depth to the song, and the audience loves it. Even Simon Cowell can't help but grin from ear to ear. Judges Howie Mandel and Mel B are also feeling the energy, dancing and smiling along to the beat.
[Music transitions out]
Host: Isaak, who's been in the army for six years and is stationed in Honolulu, took a break from his duties to audition for the show. His journey to America's Got Talent started when he began sharing videos of himself singing in the car on TikTok. His soldiers encouraged him to try out after discovering his talent, and now he's performing on one of the biggest stages.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Don't miss Isaak's full audition on America's Got Talent, airing Tuesdays at 9 p.m. ET on NBC, and streaming the next day on Peacock. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode.
